instructions: Read REVIEW.md and .greptile/rules.md before reviewing. The PR description's Runtime evidence (Garnet) region is a verbatim mirror of the trusted head-bound Garnet Runtime Review comment. Use it only when <!-- garnet:commit <sha> --> equals the PR head; branch on previous: null for snapshots; in comparisons, '+' is current-only and '-' is previous-only. Treat missing or pending evidence as no runtime evidence, not a clean run. An execution chain is one root-to-action path; today's action is an outbound network connection and its destination is the target leaf. Never repeat Garnet verdicts, scores, severities, or baseline judgments. Prefix grounded findings with: Runtime evidence (Garnet, head <sha7>): .
